name: android-forge
description: Scaffold and guide pure-Android Jetpack Compose apps — phones, tablets and foldables by default; opt-in Wear OS, TV, Android Auto, Android Automotive OS, XR, Googlebook/desktop, Cast and widgets. Drives Google's Android CLI (android create, emulators, devices, docs, skills), overlays a locked stack (Hilt, Orbit, Navigation 3 api/impl features, Room, Retrofit), CI, product workflow, an autonomous build loop and release plumbing.
